name: Haus Gerlinde Danler
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily located in Neustift, Haus Gerlinde Danler delights visitors with comfortable guestrooms and sincere personal care. It makes an ideal launchpad for valley excursions.

The Elfer mountain lifts, the Stubai Glacier, and scenic walking trails are close at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Gerlinde Danler in Neustift im Stubaital offers family hospitality facing the glacier peaks.
